name: Lieke de Vries
bio:
Lieke's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rebuilding engines alongside her grandfather, a retired mechanic. That early exposure sparked a lifelong passion for the intricate mechanics of racing vehicles. After graduating from a vocational technical school, Lieke joined a local racing team, honing her skills in fabrication and repair. Her dedication to precision and efficiency quickly earned her a reputation as a reliable and innovative fabricator.

Lieke's approach to her work is characterized by meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement. She is always seeking new ways to optimize designs and materials to enhance performance and durability. Her transition to Peugeot TotalEnergies was driven by a desire to work on cutting-edge technology and contribute to a team pushing the boundaries of motorsport innovation. She is known for her ability to quickly adapt to new challenges and her unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality work, even under pressure. Lieke is also known for her innovative solutions to manufacturing challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Lieke is of average height with a lean build, reflecting her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool on her keychain.
Insists on listening to classical music while working on complex fabrication tasks.
Checks and re-checks her measurements at least three times before cutting any materials.
